title: Managerial Prosocial Preferences and Guilt as an Emotional Barrier to Exit Decisions
eligible_reason: No binary staggered treatment. The field study regresses firm exit (and divestiture, R&D) on continuous Chinese import competition (trad_exp, from Autor-Dorn-Hanson), a prosociality proxy ('we' pronoun use, employee prosocial language, external CEO, CEO charity) and their interaction, with firm FE, year FE (or SIC4 x year FE), nine time-varying controls and two-way clustering (gvkey, sic). The remaining studies are online experiments. The ft_borusyak flag presumably comes from a citation in the text.
design_notes: Compustat firm-year panel 2002-2010 merged with trade exposure (trade_exposure_yearly.dta) and CEO proxies (PEI_replication file_MS.dta). Table 3 (Replication Code.xlsx, sheet 'Table 3_Main Table'): reghdfe exit trad_exp <proxy> trad_x<proxy> roa q debt fs fs1 altz ln_at hhi hhi_sq if year>=2002, absorb(gvkey year) or absorb(gvkey year_sic), vce(cluster gvkey sic); proxies we_use2, fair, external (also CEOtenure<4), CHA. Appendix A.1: proxies on trad_exp; A.2: lagged 'we' use; A.4: exit at t+1..t+3; Appendix B: divestiture (SDC data not shipped); Appendix C: R&D. exit = 1 in the firm's last Compustat year (set to missing if roa < -1).
estimators_reported: twfe_continuous_treatment_x_moderator_with_controls (firm FE, year or SIC4 x year FE, two-way cluster)

specs.exclusion_reason: continuous treatment (import competition) and continuous/binary moderator interactions; time-varying controls
specs.code_file: Keum and Liu_Replication Code.xlsx (sheet 'Table 3_Main Table', rows 19-31)
specs.outcome: exit (= 1 in the firm's final Compustat year; labelled Exit t+1)
specs.treatment_definition: Chinese import competition (ADH trade exposure / 100) interacted with managerial prosociality proxies
specs.fe: gvkey, year (odd columns) or gvkey, year_sic = SIC4 x year (even columns)
specs.controls: roa q debt fs fs1 altz ln_at hhi hhi_sq (time-varying)
specs.notes: Published coefficients are reproduced in the xlsx sheet (e.g. col 1 interaction -0.733, SE 0.177, N 3,368).

data_files: Experiment Data.xlsx (experimental studies; also at https://osf.io/g6uqv)
data_files_note: Field data shipped except SDC divestiture counts (licensing). Raw Compustat/ExecuComp/BoardEx inputs are licensed.
software_notes: Stata 15; the replication code is stored as text in the tabs of Keum and Liu_Replication Code.xlsx rather than in .do files.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). The regression list data/packages/mnsc.2023.02533_regressions.txt is empty because the code lives in an xlsx workbook; commands were read with openpyxl.
